sources.binary: El-Badry, Rix & Heintz (2021, MNRAS 506, 2269) list TOI-6034 and BD+67 1294 in their Gaia EDR3 wide-binary catalogue (VizieR J/MNRAS/506/2269, source_id 2270404997834401664 and 2270407952771897472), 4,700 AU apart on the sky, with a chance-alignment probability of 3.6e-4: the pair is bound.
